entries.summary: Der Straubinger Pfarrer Johann von Dietzesau (Dietzesaw) wird innerhalb des würzburgischen Geleits zwischen Kitzingen und Würzburg von Georg von Rosenberg (Rosenberg) gefangen und um 1000 Gulden beraubt. Bischof Rudolf von Scherenberg muss deshalb 1500 Gulden an Herzog Albrecht IV. von Bayern zahlen.

Rudolf hertzoge Albrechten von Bairn 1500 fl. bezalen mussen Pauli Conversionis 1487, 3 contractuum Rudolfi 271.
entries.english: Johann von Dietzesau, parish priest in Straubing, was captured by Georg von Rosenberg while travelling under Würzburg’s safe-conduct between Kitzingen and Würzburg and robbed of 1,000 florins. As a result, Rudolf, Bischof, had to pay Duke Albrecht of Bavaria 1,500 florins for him on the Feast of the Conversion of St Paul, 1487, according to the third register of Rudolf’s contracts, fol. 271.

facts.content: captured Johann von Dietzesau while he was travelling under Würzburg safe conduct between Kitzingen and Würzburg and ransomed him.
